question: Towards the close of the summer season, pre-monsoon showers are common, especially in Kerala and Karnataka. These showers are referred to as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mango Showers**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **There are pre-monsoon showers towards the end of the summer in Kerala and the coastal areas of Karnataka**.
 
• These are known as **Mango showers**__.
 __
 
• These showers are known as mango showers since they help in the early ripening of the mangoes.
 
• These showers are also known as 'April rains' or 'Summer showers'.
 
• It **Usually occur from March to April, but their arrival can be unpredictable**
 
• **It is **Common in Kerala, Karnataka, and parts of Tamil Nadu in India
 
• It Help mangoes ripen early and prevent them from dropping prematurely from trees
